# Biniyam Abera

> A production-grade, ultra-fast full-stack showcase featuring a live creator analytics SaaS, secure admin controls, and modern Next.js architecture engineered for human users and AI search engines alike.

I am a full-stack developer specializing in building high-performance, scalable web applications and SaaS platforms. I design and engineer end-to-end solutions using Next.js, Express, Tailwind CSS v4, and MongoDB. My work focuses on bridging robust backend architecture—like dual-role authentication and real-time data aggregation—with premium, ultra-fast, and highly accessible user interfaces.
